summary: Emma Harte has trained her grand-daughter, Paula, to 'hold the dream' and retain intact the vast business empire that is her legacy from Emma. But will the burden prove too heavy?

name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
summary: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness
summary: President and Mrs. Obama wanted to honor America's 250th anniversary and celebrate the unique history of our nation on this special occasion. ...But then Larry David called.

name: Babies
summary: Babies is a warm and touching drama which explores the delicate tightrope of love and loss in a young couple's desire to become parents. Lisa and Stephen are dealing with the painful struggle of pregnancy loss while life continues around them. However, despite facing dark times of grief and loneliness, they are finding their way through it with a burning sense of hope, humour, and love, realising the strength of their relationship, which will ultimately bring them closer than ever.

name: Seeking Persephone
summary: Persephone marries the feared, scarred Duke of Kielder to save her family. Her gentle persistence begins to soften his guarded heart, but when danger strikes, he must choose between protecting himself or losing the woman he's grown to love.

name: Headmaster
summary: The relationship between the headmaster of an elite California private school and his students and faculty.

name: Andy's Dino Island
summary: Andy and Jen travel back in time for epic adventures on an island filled with dinosaurs! From Dino Island, the intrepid duo unravel mysteries, solve problems and make exciting new discoveries.

name: Disaster Strike Force
summary: Leading geoscientist Dr. Molly Martin sees Earth at a tipping point as climate change fuels natural disasters. Rather than wait for bureaucracy, she and her family join international disaster response unit R.E.A.C.T.

name: The Black Tower
summary: Frustrated with his career, Commander Dalgliesh is invited to Toynton Grange, a home for the disabled, by his old teacher, Father Baddeley, who is resident there. But unbeknown to Dalgliesh, something happening at the Grange is making the Father uneasy, and Dalgliesh quickly finds himself investigating a series of mysterious deaths.

name: A Taste for Death
summary: Sir Paul Berowne - a prominent Government Minister - turns to his old friend Adam Dalgleish following a series of threatening letters delivered to his London home. The minister's wife is in an adulterous affair with a prominent surgeon and she makes no secret of it. Berowne's only daughter is involved in left-wing politics and rejects her conservative father. Adding to his woes, his own mother favoured her son who was killed in an IRA terrorist ambush over Paul. The informal investigation has barely began when Dalgliesh is faced with a series of bizarre deaths that turn the case into an urgent assignment.

name: A Certain Justice
summary: Commander Adam Dalgliesh is drawn into the inner chambers of the British legal system to investigate the grisly murder of Venetia Aldridge, an ambitious - and widely despised - criminal lawyer. As the list of suspects quickly grows to include several key members of Aldridge's firm, each with an excellent motive for murder, suspicion also falls on Gary Ashe, a murder suspect Venetia recently defended - successfully - and who has since taken up with her daughter Octavia. As Dalgliesh probes Venetia's past, a terrible secret about her father emerges and appears to be linked to her death - as well as to a distinguished member of Chambers.

name: Missing from Home
summary: Drama serial about a middle-aged housewife who has to cope alone when her husband disappears.

name: Iggy and Mr. Kirk
summary: Laugh, learn, sing, and play along with Iggy the Iguana in Iggy and Mr. Kirk. Watch as Iggy discovers the importance of honesty, forgiveness, bravery, and more! Iggy may not have it all figured out, but thanks to Mr. Kirk, Iggy's friends, and some great Freedom Island stories, he'll grow a little more each day.

name: Comedy InvAsian
summary: Comedy InvAsian is both a live and filmed series featuring the nation's top and most unique six Asian American comedians each performing a one-hour special. In an era where diversity in entertainment is a necessity, Comedy InvAsian is the brainchild effort of producers Koji Steven Sakai and Quentin Lee to showcase and celebrate the diversity of Asian American comedy in both genre and representation to the world.

name: Dick and Dom's Funny Business
summary: Dick and Dom's Funny Business finds the dynamic duo in a theatre running their own comedy business, showcasing the cream of the new British comedy crop. Each week their venue will play host to an established comedy star and brand new sketch acts.

name: Captain James Cook
summary: Based on Captain James Cook's three voyages. It was on his first voyage, in 1770 (while in the South Pacific region to observe the transit of Venus), that Captain Cook discovered the east coast of Australia. He later recommended Australia as a future British colony. Made principally on location, using a full-size replica of the 'Endeavour' (built for the Australian bicentenary), this has a salty atmosphere lacking from many historial 'sea dramas'. Michell's performance as the titular Yorkshireman has also been praised for its complexity.

name: National Velvet
summary: A series about a girl named Velvet who, after acquiring a horse, dedicates herself to training and dreaming of the day it wins a great race. Based on Enid Bagnold's best- selling novel and the MGM film, the TV version has been moved in locale from England to an American dairy farm region. It remains, however, the simple heart-warming story of a 12-year-old girl, her horse, and her great dream of winning a famous steeplechase. Most of all, "National Velvet" is the story of the Brown family — Herbert Brown, a modestly successful dairy farmer, played by Arthur Space; his wife, Martha Brown, portrayed by veteran actress Ann Doran; Edwina Brown, Velvel's boy-crazy older sister, played by Carole Wells, and small Donald Brown, a role filled by 7-year- old Joey Scott. Handyman Mi Taylor, who abets Velvet in many of her plans concerning the beautiful horse, is played by James McCallion.

name: Legends
summary: Surrounded by drug lords, a team of regular civil servants faces a nerve-racking undercover mission to take them down.

name: TechTown
summary: At TechTown , Alan, Adam, Ellie, Britt and their manager Rowan rarely get any real work done, often finding themselves bored to death.

name: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries
summary: Cheryl Cooper escapes to an Amish community in Sugarcreek, Ohio, to manage a gift shop after a failed engagement. Drawn into one mystery after another, Cheryl quickly realizes her sharp instincts and outsider perspective are exactly what this tight-knit community needs.

name: Make That Movie
summary: Make That Movie focuses on a hotshot director, played by stand-up comedian and actor Sam Campbell who scours the country for everyday people who have an idea for a feature film. Sam and his team then race against the clock as they attempt to transform the idea into a film in just three days.

name: Amy's Dead-End Dreamhouse
summary: Welcome to Amy's Dead-End Dreamhouse ! Follow Amy and her apartment full of appliances as they encounter all kinds of adult problems, from mental illness, to job hunting, to impossible beauty standards, to your guy friends getting red-pilled. Turns out, life can't really be solved in under 20 minutes, even with commercial breaks.

name: Mama I'm A Thot
summary: Darnell aspires to be an astronaut, but his rough neighborhood presents unforeseen challenges. Confronting hardship, friendship, and survival, his destiny remains uncertain. Can he overcome his environment or will it consume him?

name: The Witness
summary: From 2-year-old to teen, this coming-of-age drama based on true events follows the story of Alex Hanscombe who witnessed his mother's murder in 1992.

name: New Zealand Spy
summary: New Zealand's newest spies - and the only three who applied - are tasked with protecting our nation from incoming threats, most notably those noisy neighbours in Australia.

name: Be a Man With Me
summary: When masculinity becomes a punchline, Pawel Widawski tests it the hard way. He joins cops, farmers, and MMA fighters across America, usually getting wrecked in the process. Bruised, humbled, and laughing, Pawel discovers what real toughness looks like (and how many ice packs it takes to survive it).

name: The New Statesman
summary: George Vance is the custodian of an agricultural museum near Aylesbury. One day he receives news that will change his, and the British, way of life for ever.

name: The Lady Grace Mysteries
summary: 14-year-old Lady Grace teams up with her best friends to dive into a world of royal secrets. From balls and feasts, to wild adventures (and even the ghost of Henry VIII), Grace is about to uncover more than just the truth — she's going to change everything.

name: Ann Droid
summary: It's Sue's worst nightmare - an overly attentive, socially inept, second-hand robot carer. But maybe this droid has its uses...

name: Jupiter Jones
summary: A spin-off of ALLBLK's popular original series A House Divided, following fan-favorite Jupiter Jones - a sharp-witted lawyer tackling high-profile scandals and conspiracies while battling a haunted past. A thrilling mix of legal drama, betrayal, and redemption.

name: Crime and Punishment
summary: Living in squalor, a former student and loner (Raskolnikov) murders an old pawnbroker woman in order to confirm his hypothesis that certain individuals can pretermit morality in the pursuit of something greater.

name: True Heiress vs. Fake Queen Bee
summary: Hailey Kaplan, a wealthy teenager who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to Western High, a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hailey hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life. However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Candice Mathis, the daughter of the Kaplan family's maid, arrives at school posing as the Kaplan heiress. Candice quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hailey finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.

name: Escorting the Heiress
summary: Serena caught her boyfriend, Ken cheating on her with her half-sister, Carol. He had always lied about holding it all in till marriage. Furious by their actions, Serena gets drunk and ended up in the bed of Jesse. She thought he was her escort but he was a man who has been inlove with her for years.

name: My Secret Husband Is My Boss
summary: Kate married a stranger in order to secure her inheritance without ever seeing him. She returns two years later get a divorce, not knowing that her hot billionaire boss and crush Jack Townsend is her secret husband.

name: Froglets
summary: For the Froglets , the human world is a giant playground full of everyday challenges and wonders that spark an urge to adapt, get creative, play and have lots of fun along the way.

name: Ride or Die
summary: Ride or Die follows best friends Debbie Claybourne and Judith Burton who thought they knew everything about each other, except Judith turns out to be an international assassin. When a mysterious figure emerges from Judith's past and a hit goes horribly wrong, both of their worlds are turned upside down as they're forced to go on the run together. It's a race against time and a road trip across Europe, with law enforcement, highly trained assassins, and some very dangerous criminals at their heels.

name: Two D's and a Dog
summary: Two D's and a Dog follows Dotty Charles after the death of her father, as she travels with her friend Dingle Bell and her dog Fido in search of work.

name: The Old Stories: Moses
summary: The Old Stories opens a window into the narratives that shaped Israel long before David took the throne. As the past unfolds with epic force, a young shepherd sees his own future reflected in the courage, failure, and obedience of those who came before him.

name: The Clairvoyant
summary: The Clairvoyant follows Arnold Bristow, a used car salesman whose life changes dramatically after he is struck by a car. When he regains consciousness, he becomes convinced that he has developed psychic powers.

name: The Brothers McGregor
summary: Liverpool-set sitcom about black and white half-brothers Wesley and Cyril who run an extremely dodgy second-hand car business.

name: Vengeance: Murder on the Heath
summary: Fact-based drama telling the story of the killing of 21 year old Gagandip Singh by his friend Harvinder ‘Ravi' Shoker in 2011. Branded by the press as the ‘Honeytrap Murder', the case garnered national interest for the part played by Gagandip's friend Mundill Mahil, with whom he had tried to pursue a romantic relationship.

name: Worzel Gummidge Down Under
summary: Worzel starts a new life in New Zealand in this series shot five years after the original shows made by Southern Television for the ITV Network. There are new children and a new Crowman as Worzel 's adventures continue as does his quest for true love with Aunt Sally. Many of the original crew that worked on the Southern Television series were used in these productions shown on Channel 4.

name: The Sun Trap
summary: Life on a Mediterranean island, far from strike-torn Britain, is a paradise. Or is it? The Hallidays aren't sure, and neither, it seems, is anybody else.

name: Bust Up
summary: Bust Up follows former romantic partners Deb Brighton and Mihi Renata, who are unexpectedly reunited after a decade apart and forced to work side‑by‑side as police officers in the small (fictional) town of Waitote, the garden gnome capital of Aotearoa. Together the pair must navigate a series of crimes are as bizarre as they are dangerous, and as the stakes escalate, so does the emotional tension, pushing Deb and Mihi to confront the unresolved feelings they've spent years trying to bury.

name: Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat
summary: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

name: It's Awfully Bad for Your Eyes, Darling
summary: It's Awfully Bad for Your Eyes, Darling follows the domestic trials and tribulations of Samantha, Pudding, Virginia and Clover, four single women from well-off backgrounds who share a flat in London while trying to navigate modern life.

name: Lot Patrol
summary: Lot Patrol follows a mismatched squad of eccentric security guards as they patrol the chaotic backlot of a major Hollywood studio, wrangling unhinged actors, rogue crew members, and their own wildly dysfunctional personal lives.

name: Half as Interesting
summary: Half as Interesting is an entertaining, fact-based, educational series covering diverse topics of general interest presented in a somewhat humorous, quirky style. Topics range from curious to weird and are rarely important to know unless you're looking for some lunch room or coffee break conversation starters.

name: The Season
summary: A striving American is thrown headfirst into the world of superyachts, sun, and scandal over the Hong Kong boating season in this soapy delicious revenge thriller about the wealthy and the secrets they keep. Our story follows Coleen "Cola" Li, a summer associate for a prestigious financial firm, as her mentor introduces her to "The Season": six glorious weeks in the summer where the rich and fabulous host a series of extravagant events. During the opening party aboard a superyacht, Cola meets the important players in Hong Kong. All are beautiful. All are dangerous. All are keeping a secret. But Cola is as well. She's here to get vengeance for a past injustice, no matter the cost. Over six weeks, Cola must navigate the world of the 1%, as she infiltrates high society in their private boxes at the races, charity tables at boxing matches, murder mystery parties at amusement parks, as well as the seedier side of the rich. At the end, Cola faces a choice: do I destroy these people or become them?

name: Alex Goes Bananas
summary: Alex Nickel (Technicality) was born in 2001. Join him as he discovers, reacts to, and explains pop-culture from the late 1990s and early 2000s.

name: Not Just Bikes
summary: Stories of great urban planning and urban experiences from Amsterdam and the Netherlands. It's not just bikes.

name: Come Outside
summary: Come Outside is an educational series for children. Auntie Mabel and Pippin the dog explore the world around - on the ground, under the ground and sometimes up in the air, in Auntie's aeroplane.

name: Head Girl
summary: Three Wellington flatmates try to figure out life in their 20s - Flo wants to be a poet, Dee wants to have a good time, and Sadie wants to be perfect. But they seem to be getting in each other's way.

name: The Silver Theatre
summary: The Silver Theatre is a live dramatic anthology series that aired on the CBS television network from 1949 to 1950. Rather than having a single overarching narrative, it featured stand-alone episodes focusing on the humorous, silly, frustrating, and rewarding aspects of romance. Each 30-minute episode starred a different rotating cast of prominent Hollywood actors and was sponsored by the International Silver Company.

name: Possession
summary: Claudia, an ambitious young bi‑racial lawyer, travels to Jamaica to challenge an inheritance claim made by a local man, Cudjoe East, against Oliver Connaught, a wealthy white aristocrat. But the case takes an unsettling turn when Claudia discovers that the disputed estate is the very place that has haunted her nightmares: Hope Hill, the Connaught family's former plantation. As Claudia and Oliver dig deeper, they uncover a disturbing link between the plantation's brutal past and the injustices still shaping the present.

name: Pulitzer Prize Playhouse
summary: Pulitzer Prize Playhouse is a classic 1950–1952 dramatic anthology series that featured weekly adaptations of Pulitzer Prize-winning plays, novels, and stories. Hosted and narrated by journalist Elmer Davis , the television program brought prestigious literary and theatrical works to the growing American medium.

name: Twist of Fate
summary: SS-Lieutenant Colonel Helmut Von Schreader conceives an unusual plan to escape the aftermath of the Second World War by disguising himself as a Jewish Concentration Camp victim. Under the alias of Ben Grossman, Von Schreader is liberated from the camps and immigrates to Palestine where he joins the Zionist movement.

name: The Far Country
summary: Two people from different backgrounds escaping their own past and finding a new life in post World War 2 Australia, can their pasts be left behind? Can the war be forgotten?

name: Please Don't Break Anything
summary: Four months after a night gone horribly wrong, Billie holds a gathering in honour of her dead best friend. But as the night unfolds, she realises her mates may be hiding more than they seem.

name: L.O.L. Surprise! The Next Headliner
summary: Five aspiring performers compete for a coveted music industry opportunity, only to discover that their greatest strength lies in collaboration rather than rivalry. As they navigate friendship, self-doubt and the pressures of pursuing a music career, they form a band and chart their own path to stardom.

name: Baddies
summary: After a botched bank heist and a stolen cop car collide, four misfit kids sent to a dodgy youth camp find themselves standing between a crew of robbers and a million bucks.

name: Aperture R&D
summary: After losing a fellow scientist, Nik and Charles must decide how much they're willing to risk for the Lab Team of the Month title.

name: Sugar and Spice
summary: Pixie and Molly are arch enemies, as different as sugar and spice. During the 1920s, they are forced to leave home to attend high school — together. They travel hundreds of miles from the tiny settlement of Coolwong, deep in the Australian outback, to a big country town — together. The girls begin a new life with a new family. Together they fight, laugh, join the Girl Guides, fly in a biplane, discover Rudolph Valentino — and together, they grow up to understand one another. A warm, humorous and exciting story of two very strong-willed girls and the development of a most unlikely friendship.

name: Jackie, Ethel, Joan: The Women of Camelot
summary: They were more than Washington wives. They were part of an American dream known as Camelot. With strength and cunning they upheld their public image by concealing their private truths. Jackie, Ethel and Joan had little choice.

name: City '68
summary: City '68 was a anthology drama set in the fictional, bustling Lancashire city of Fylde. Supposedly located on the north bank of the River Ribble—geographically nestled between Preston and Blackpool—Fylde was imagined as a massive industrial hub home to over three-quarters of a million residents. The series used this fictional backdrop as a microcosm to explore the emerging social, economic, and personal conflicts of late-1960s urban British life.

name: Gayle
summary: Gayle's a middle-aged woman, stay at home mom type who descends deeper into madness each week. She's frantic and desperate and will stop at nothing to maintain status in her community.

name: Paris is Always a Good Idea
summary: Career-driven nonprofit executive Chelsea Martin travels to Paris with her confident rival-turned-ally, Jason Knightly to secure a major donation but a heartfelt message from her late mother – and a loving push from her sister Annabelle – sends her on an unexpected journey to reconnect with the three great loves she once left behind. From the rolling hills of Ireland to the magic of Paris and the sun-kissed vineyards of Spain, Chelsea retraces old footsteps and discovers that sometimes moving forward means first looking back.

name: Hypersonic
summary: A known terrorist launches a surprise cyber-attack on the U.S in order to gain control over their hypersonic missiles. FBI director Karen Smith enlists the help of two ex-military black ops soldiers to hunt down the culprits.

name: D.O.P.E. Unit
summary: A covert crime drama set in Philadelphia, following an off-the-books undercover task force known as the D.O.P.E. Unit as it wages a secret war against powerful crime families. As violence escalates and political pressure mounts, the series explores systemic corruption, moral ambiguity, and the consequences of institutional choices in a world where loyalty and justice collide. As the operation deepens, personal lives unravel, trust erodes, and every decision carries a cost that reshapes the mission and those sworn to uphold it.

name: The Disappointments
summary: In this darkly comic series, three gay friends in their late 50s are forced to face the fact that their lives have fallen far short of what they imagined for themselves when they were in their 20s. Dreams of wealth, career success, and lasting love have faded, replaced by a growing sense of the clock ticking and an urgent need to turn their disappointing lives around - before they are literally out of time.

name: Locker Diaries: Descendants
summary: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Auradon Prep and discover the secret adventures that unfold.

name: The Airport Chaplain
summary: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace has an unorthodox approach to solving the daily crises of an airport, constantly overstepping boundaries and putting him on a collision course with new boss Mira Ansari-Cole. Mira wants him fired but Tobias isn't giving up his beloved chaplaincy without a fight.

name: Black Harbour
summary: Her mother's illness and her director husband's career slump force a Los Angeles chef to return to her hometown in Nova Scotia, where she finds a new beginning running the family's boatyard.

name: The Varnell Hill Show
summary: Nearly three decades after audiences first met him, Varnell Hill is stepping back into the spotlight - and he's determined to prove he's still the star of the show. Set behind the scenes of a long-running late-night talk show, The Varnell Hill Show follows Varnell as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.

name: Knight Errant Limited
summary: The enthusiasm is palpable, yet there don't seem to be enough causes to channel it into anymore. This sentiment might resonate with the modern young person and could very well be what inspired Adam Knight, the protagonist of Granada's new hour-long series 'Knight Errant '59,' to pursue his new venture. Adam Knight, portrayed by John Turner, is a young man who, after dabbling in various occupations, decides he wants a job that blends interest and excitement. He dubs himself Knight Errant and establishes a business to assist anyone in any situation. There's certainly no shortage of opportunities for him, and Adam, akin to a modern-day Sir Lancelot, finds himself continuously occupied. Assisting Adam is Liz Parish, a former newspaper columnist who left her position to become his indispensable partner. Liz embodies chicness, charm, wit, wisdom, sophistication, warmth, and quick wit. She's as ready to lend a helping hand as she is to deliver a clever remark. Her style reflects the fashion of 1959, occasionally venturing into 1960. Naturally, she is stunning. Rounding out the regular team in the Knight Errant setup is Peter Parker, played by Richard Carpenter. He's an earnest young writer absorbed in creating a major work. Full of the typical "angry young" affectations, Peter lacks one crucial thing: money. He's held various positions—from espresso bar attendant to office cleaner—that keep him afloat financially and, as he puts it, leave his mind free for more significant pursuits.

name: Fighting Back
summary: After walking out on her drunken husband in Liverpool, Viv Sharpe travels to her native Bristol with her two children. There she finds that her mother has died and no one wants to know her or help her.

name: Sam
summary: Sam, a Labrador Retriever, works with Officer Mike Breen. Despite showing excellent sensory and physical abilities on patrol, Captain Clagett remains skeptical of the K-9 program.

name: Dalliance
summary: Dalliance follows retired cameraman Billy who unexpectedly crosses paths with chef Dani. An instant connection threatens to unravel decades of friendship and family. As one life-changing event sends shockwaves through an entire community, marriages are tested, new relationships ignite, old wounds resurface, and everyone is forced to confront the choices that have shaped their lives.

name: Serial
summary: In Ashbourne Falls, Harold hides in plain sight, a quiet man with a dark compulsion to kill. Mabel, a disgraced nurse, moves through life with a dark secret. This is the story of two killers destined to collide.

name: Settling
summary: Two disillusioned 30-somethings carry out their teenage pact - a platonic marriage - to satisfy family and societal expectations.

name: Doom Castle
summary: Serial concerning the Jacobite attempts to aid the return of Bonnie Prince Charlie to Britain.

name: Danny Go!
summary: "Danny Go!" is a live-action educational children's show filled with music, learning and silliness. Created in 2019 by 3 childhood friends in Charlotte, North Carolina, the purpose of the show is to inspire creativity, confidence and kindness in kids from ages 2-7.

name: Moonbird
summary: On a remote island off the coast of Lutruwita (Tasmania), a 13-year-old Palawa boy navigates the complexities of his world alongside his father, a man shaped by his past and the challenges of raising his son.

name: Knights of the Cross
summary: Knights of the Cross is an epic Christian mini-series set during the Third Crusade. King Richard the Lionheart battles illness, doubt, and Sultan Saladin in a decisive struggle for Jerusalem and the future of Christendom.

name: Barking!
summary: This live-action children's comedy follows a teenage girl adjusting to a fresh start in a quiet Devon town after her family relocates. To help smooth the transition, her new stepfather gifts her a pet dog. The twist: the dog secretly possesses the ability to talk, and she is the only person who knows! Mischievous, loud-mouthed, and wildly opinionated, the canine companion constantly drags his owner into ridiculous everyday scrapes, but despite the inevitable chaos, the two form an unbreakable bond as best friends.

name: Dugout Dads
summary: Follows an idealistic dad who volunteers to coach his kids' Little League team and discovers that the most unruly players aren't the ten-year-olds but the other coaches, parents, and sometimes himself. For the first time in 33 years, the original cast of The Sandlot reunites on screen in Dugout Dads, a heartfelt comedy about a first-time Little League coach who quickly discovers that while the kids are just there to have fun, the adults are playing for keeps.

name: Big Eddie
summary: A reformed mobster and former gambler attempts to go straight by managing a New York sports arena. To secure legal custody of his young orphaned granddaughter, he marries his ex-stripper girlfriend, creating a chaotic household. The series follows his constant struggle to navigate a legitimate business and respectable domestic life while fending off eccentric former underworld cronies who keep dragging him back into his past.

name: Jack Reed
summary: The Jack Reed series was a collection of six NBC made-for-TV crime drama movies broadcast between 1992 and 1996. Starring Brian Dennehy as the real-life Cook County Homicide Investigator, the overarching premise for the franchise focuses on a dedicated, old-school Chicago police sergeant who battles both ruthless criminals and deep-seated internal department bureaucracy to solve high-profile mu

name: The Bill Dana Show
summary: The Bill Dana Show follows the sweet, naive, and well-meaning Latin American immigrant José Jiménez as he navigates daily life and misadventures working as a bellhop at a swanky, upscale hotel in New York City

name: The Brothers
summary: Two polar-opposite brothers—one shy and retiring, the other excitable and domineering—navigate comedic misadventures and sibling rivalry while co-running a photography studio in San Francisco.

name: Charlie & Co.
summary: Follows the Richmond family, headed by dad Charlie, a blue-collar worker, and his wife Diana.

name: Children's Hospital
summary: Children's Hospital follows the dramatic, fast-paced, and emotional daily lives of the doctors, nurses, and young patients navigating a busy pediatric ward.

name: The Charlie Farrell Show
summary: The Charlie Farrell Show follows a semi-fictionalized version of a retired film star who runs the prestigious Palm Springs Racquet Club in California

name: The Life and Crimes of William Palmer
summary: Keith Allen plays William Palmer in this true story of a Victorian-era English surgeon who uses poison to settle scores and ward off debt. William lacks a sense of regret, even after killing his wife, brother and three of his own children.

name: Bo! in the USA
summary: Leigh Francis reprises his role of Avid Merrion and along with Barunka O'Shaughnessy, as his wife and sister Sacha, opens a hotel in L.A. full of celebrities, including past favourites Craig David and George Michael.

name: The Cheetah Girls
summary: Four teens face the challenges of growing up as they sing and dance their way toward an elusive record deal as a girl group.

name: Middlehood
summary: For Lisa Giordano Navarro, midlife is messy. At 50, she crashes head-on into a moment when the years she's lived meet the years she has left - and it scares her. So she blows up her life for a chance at a do-over.

name: Comedy Inc.
summary: Comedy Inc. was an Australian sketch comedy television series featuring predominantly send-ups and impersonations of well known personalities and TV Shows.

name: Timmy and Vicki
summary: Timmy and Vicki is a two-part play about two young teenagers navigating their first serious relationship, with each episode told from one of their points of view.
